description: This script filters fonts.xml to include only desired font packages based on categories, and can output a list of font files for GYP build system integration.

methods.name: SelectFont
methods.description: Determines whether a font node should be kept based on package category, weight, and style.

methods.name: FilterFonts
methods.description: Recursively filters font nodes in the XML document based on a predicate function.

methods.name: GetContainerName
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the name of a container node of a specified type.

methods.name: DoMain
methods.description: Main function handling argument parsing, XML processing, and output generation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that calls DoMain with command-line arguments.
